program.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Make this look like a comic book photo
requirements.source_phrase: Make this look like a comic book photo

outcomes.description: Transform the image so it has a comic-book visual style while retaining its photographic subject matter.
outcomes.target: The image visibly combines comic-book styling with a photographic appearance.
outcomes.reference: The supplied image, as edited; assess the overall visual treatment for comic-book styling and photographic subject matter.

nodes.question: Does the edited image visibly use comic-book visual treatment?
nodes.criteria: Pass if comic-book visual treatment is visibly present; fail if it is not; unknown if the image evidence is genuinely insufficient. Treat stylistic cues as evidence, not mandatory techniques.
nodes.binding: Assess the edited image's overall visual treatment for the requested comic-book look. Do not count framing, tonal, or other incidental differences as comic-book styling.

nodes.question: Does the edited image retain recognizable photographic subject matter and appearance?
nodes.criteria: Pass if recognizable photographic subject matter and appearance remain; fail if they do not; unknown if evidence is insufficient. This observation alone does not establish progress or fulfillment.
nodes.binding: Assess the edited image for photographic subject matter and appearance. Do not treat mere retention of the source scene as progress toward the requested edit.

nodes.question: Compared with the supplied source, does the edited image show visible progress toward a comic-book-photo appearance?
nodes.criteria: Pass if there is an attributable visible change toward comic-book styling while retaining recognizable photographic subject matter; fail if there is no such progress, including mere retention of the source appearance or incidental framing or tonal differences; unknown if comparison evidence is genuinely insufficient.
nodes.binding: Compare the supplied source and edited images for progress toward the requested comic-book-photo appearance. Do not require a particular technique or count unrelated changes. Use the ancestor observations as context, but assess the comparison independently.

nodes.question: Does the edited image fully look like a comic-book photo?
nodes.criteria: Complete only when the evidence establishes the requested comic-book-photo appearance as a whole. Partial only when requested progress is established and evidence also establishes that the overall requested appearance remains incomplete. Absent when evidence establishes no requested progress. Unknown when necessary evidence is unresolved; do not infer failure from operational errors. Photographic retention alone is not progress, and a styling cue or progress observation alone does not establish completion or incompleteness. Ignore unrelated edits.
nodes.binding: Target: The image visibly combines comic-book styling with a photographic appearance.. Reference: The supplied image, as edited; assess the overall visual treatment for comic-book styling and photographic subject matter..

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. Return status, evidence, confidence (0 to 1 or null), and used_dependency_ids. You receive no reference label or optimizer feedback. Do not predict what the optimizer wants.
Support checks receive source and edited images. Inspect only the saved visual proposition and binding. When dependencies are supplied, use those ancestor observations as context and investigate the more specific proposition yourself; do not simply repeat the parent answer. Use pass/fail/unknown. A pass on a broad parent does not imply a nested check passes. Known negative evidence is usable; uncertain or missing evidence is unknown. Do not award requested completion credit to supporting facts.
The requested fulfillment readout receives NO images. Use ALL and ONLY saved support observations, the original instruction, rubric and saved composition criteria. Use complete/partial/absent/unknown. Mere texture or object presence must not silently establish whole-image conversion or a requested spatial relation. Known progress plus evidenced incompleteness may be partial; absence means no requested progress. Missing necessary evidence is unknown, never a fabricated failure or completion. Do not infer new visual facts.
used_dependency_ids must name every supplied dependency check_id exactly once in saved order (empty when none). Confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness.
